pages.main_text: Features check Showcase your team members with stylish, professional boxes that are simple to create. check Customize team images, titles and informational text with a few easy clicks. check Adjust settings to select the image size, display style and which text features you want to include on your team pages. About One of the most important elements of online sales is to connect with your customers. Help your customers get to know your business with Team Cards — an easy way to showcase the members of your team and build beautiful team pages. Whether you create a separate team page, or add the information to an existing contact page, Team Cards create a stylish professional introduction to the hardworking people behind the scenes of your website or small business. Team Cards are free and simple to install. After you install the Team Cards App, simply drag the element to the page where it will reside. To add your team images and details, click on the icon at the top to upload a picture. Next, click anywhere on the text and start typing the team member's name, title and any other information you want to include. A shaded button provides more options: Click on it to customize the text — such as “Learn More" or “More Info" — as well as the text style, position and spacing. You can also link the button to a specific team page or site. After you've customized the team images and text, it's time to configure the settings for your Team Cards. Select the desired size (small or large) and image display (circle or filled), and decide whether to toggle on or off the title text, about text and shaded button. pages.main_text: Features check Add frequently asked questions to your website with just a few clicks. check Customize questions and answers, so users can access information without having to call or email. check Design the app to match your website design with plenty of background colors and styles. About A set of frequently asked questions, or FAQ, section on your website, can do more than answer customer questions quickly, it's also a customer service portal. The FAQ page might be the first point of contact a user or potential customer has with your website before completing another action, such as a purchase. The FAQ app can help you create an FAQ page with ease. The app is free and provides all the benefits of creating an FAQ section yourself, but with a lot less effort. Other benefits of an FAQ page include providing customer support for common questions without having a person on call at all hours, alleviating product anxieties and questions before a purchase, and improved website navigation and search. More content with more keywords related to your product selection makes it easier for users to find information on your website—and when using search engines such as Google. A dedicated FAQ section helps address the basic needs of users by allowing them to quickly and easily navigate through commonly asked questions to find a solution. It also helps create a better overall user experience. The FAQ app uses a question-and-answer format to make it simple and visually appealing at the same time. The FAQ app comes with several customizable design features that will allow it to blend in seamlessly with your website. You can also make sure your FAQ section is quickly accessible and neatly displayed. About The number one reason your customers get in touch is to ask questions about a product they bought or plan to buy. Once you know these questions and have answers for them, you can add them to our FAQ app. This will free up your support time because users will find the answers they need and won't reach out. That's why having a simple FAQ section laid out on your page is important to your bottom line. Our app allows you to control the position, the size and the layout of the list. This makes it easy to create unlimited pairs of questions and answers. After your list is complete you can embed the app in different pages on your store.
